entries.name: Fisher’s Catechism
entries.description: James Fisher and Ebenezer Erskine’s exposition of the Westminster Shorter Catechism: about 3,800 questions and answers, arranged under each Shorter Catechism question, with Scripture cited in the answers.
entries.coverage_note: This text was transcribed from a supplied digital edition and has not been proofread against a printed one. Numbering and page-layout irregularities in that edition may remain in places. James Fisher’s prefaces are included; the publisher’s introduction, editorial footnotes and index are not. Topics are the Shorter Catechism questions each item explains.

entries.name: Westminster Confession of Faith
entries.description: The Westminster Confession of Faith: 33 chapters, 172 numbered sections, each with its Scripture references.

source.title: The Westminster Confession of Faith
source.translation: Scripture proofs given as references only
source.notes: Public domain. Text transcribed from the unrevised (pre-1788) Westminster Confession as published by apuritansmind.com, which reformed.org's historic-documents index links to. Compared with the Orthodox Presbyterian Church's text (the American revision): the two agree except where the 1788 revision changed the chapters on the civil magistrate, marriage, church synods and the head of the church, and in scattered single-word variants (for example V.5, VII.3, XIII.2 and XVI.3). It has not yet been proofread against a standard printed edition.

entries.coverage_note: Scripture references are shown as citations; the text of each passage is not yet included.
